messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — putting together the invite cadence and gating checklist for the Private beta. Need alignment on must-have controls we require before invite (SLA, KMS, on‑prem checklist).
Aj Chen: +1. can we gate on a minimum commit? e.g., 3 months reserved capacity or explicit pilot statement of use.
Kevin Li: I think commit levels scare some partners off. Suggest tiered invites: early integrators (no commit) vs validation partners (commit required).
Sara Patel: Agree with Kevin. Also we should require an internal security sign-off for on‑prem installs. Not optional.
Maria Gomez: Proposed gating matrix (high level):
- Security: KMS or HSM present, offline/network policy documented
- SLA expectations: target latency SLO and availability window agreed
- Data posture: RTP ok vs air‑gapped
- Commitment: pilot length + optional reserved capacity
Aj Chen: That looks good. For recruitment messaging, we should call out incentives: 1) priority roadmap influence 2) discounted reserved pricing 3) dedicated onboarding RT.
Kevin Li: Add: a scoped engineering time allocation (e.g., 8-16 hours onboarding support) so partners know effort required.
Maria Gomez: Draft DM template for outreach — please comment:```Hi <name>, we're running a limited Private beta for Redwood Private focused on on‑prem inference and VPC control planes. Looking for 3 design partners to pilot integrations and policy controls. Benefits: priority influence on roadmap, discounted reserved capacity, dedicated onboarding support. Estimated time: 2–4 weeks to initial rollout, engineering support available. Interested?```
Sara Patel: Nice. Add an explicit line about NDAs and data handling: "All interactions covered by our pilot NDA; we can accommodate additional DPA requests."
Aj Chen: Feedback loop plan — propose weekly async check-ins + 2 live sessions (kickoff + retrospective). Collect prompts/evals, latency/cost reports, and a short integration diary from partner.
Kevin Li: For success criteria, we should measure: integration completed, end-to-end latency within agreed SLO, <X% inference error/regression vs baseline, and partner satisfaction (NPS-like).
Maria Gomez: Can we define X? I'd propose initial targets: p95 latency < 300ms for typical gen workloads, regression < 5% for quality evals. Open to adjustments per partner.
Sara Patel: Sounds reasonable. Also track time-to-first-inference (TTFI) as an ops usability metric.
Aj Chen: Rollout plan: cohort size 3–5 for this phase. Prioritize customers with existing infra similarity to our target personas (on-prem infra, security/compliance teams).
Kevin Li: Recruitment channels: AE outreach, existing Dedicated customers, community forum thread, and targeted LinkedIn PMs. Use a short form to capture infra profile + pilot goals.
Maria Gomez: Short form fields: company, contact, infra (onprem/cloud/hybrid), expected qps, use case, compliance needs, desired launch date, commitment level.
Sara Patel: Who owns outreach copy and the form? I can own copy, Aj can wire up the Typeform and AE routing.
Aj Chen: I'll set up the form and a Trello for partner status. recruit-bot: created pilot-invite form -> https://example.typeform.com/redwood-priv-beta (auto post).
Maria Gomez: Nice. Next: negotiation playbook for scope creep — keep the initial pilot focused on onboarding + one integrator use case. Any additional feature asks go into a prioritized backlog with explicit roll-forward windows.
Kevin Li: Agree. We should include a change request template: what, why, impact, timeline. If partner requests > 2 new features during pilot, that moves them to "extended feature work" scope with separate comms.
Sara Patel: Timeline: outreach opens next Tue, close invites in 2 weeks, kickoff for cohort 1 in 4 weeks. We need sign-off on the gating matrix and incentives today or tomorrow.
Maria Gomez: OK team — final call: are we comfortable with the gating matrix + incentives as written? If no objections by EOD I'll publish the invite and share the link with AE. :thumbsup:
Aj Chen: :thumbsup:
Kevin Li: :thumbsup:
Sara Patel: :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Great — I'll post the public invite copy to #sales and drop the onboarding checklist in the repo after posting. Thanks!
